population_note_text: Every debit line on a ledger under Purchase Accounts, Direct Expenses or Indirect Expenses, in the books population; credits on those ledgers that match are shown beside.

figures.definition_text: Clause 21(a) (i) capital expenditure: the P&L debits matched as candidates, summed -- a candidate total, not a reportable amount.
Credits on the same P&L ledgers matching the (i) capital expenditure words: shown beside, never netted.

findings.title_text: Clause 21(a) (i) capital expenditure: candidates listed for the CA, not reported
limits_text: 1 P&L debit line(s) match the words for this item (ICAI GN on tax audit (2025) ch.33 paras 33.2-33.6; the clause 21(a) candidate spec (repairs/software/computer ledgers, purchase narrations, preliminary expenses)); a match is a candidate, never a conclusion, and nothing is left out for being small. The CA decides what, if anything, is reported; no clause 21(a) row is written.

Only lines on ledgers under Purchase Accounts, Direct Expenses or Indirect Expenses were searched. Keyword recall is not measured: a narration in Hindi, Hinglish or left blank is missed, and a penalty booked only in the GST cash ledger, netted in a party account, or on a credit-card statement is not in these books.
ask_client_text: Is any of this capital expenditure debited to P&L (enduring benefit, fixed asset, intangible, preliminary expenses)? Confirm the amount per item, and whether an accounting-standard observation is needed in para 3 of 3CA / para 3(a) of 3CB.
